comparison: Outperforms full 2-state Adam-MP (11/15 vs 9/15) by +2 tasks (recovering both t3_iso probes) at a fraction of state memory, while confirming that rank-preserving diagonal/factored preconditioning cannot replace Quintic NS on 16-layer rank-1-collapsed grid100_mlp16.
conclusion: Sublinear-memory O(m+n) Adafactor row/col factored RMS + MP + peak_rms + secant band (0 NS) achieves 11/15 graded PASS (4 numerical FAIL, 1 contention-TIMEOUT on five_word_joint_smoke) on r4-occam-ablation-v1, strictly beating full 2-state O(mn) law4-adam-equil (9/15) with O(m+n) state! Passes grid100 (prec=0.9922, ctr=0.1218), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), both >500x Nash tasks (hq=0.9600/0.9712), ring16 (0.9810), vector_unequal_mass/width (eig=0.3916/0.4860), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.4668), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (hq=0.9297), and both smokes. Fails only grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.1737), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0_mean=0.4924), gaussian1d_stability, and zero_tanh_rail_escape (mae=0.00633).
